text: The following question stood in the name of Er Dr Lee Bee Wah –

7 To ask Minister for National Development (a) how has the coordination of services been since the launch of the Municipal Services Office; and (b) which Government agency should be contacted when there is a python found in a monsoon drain and the AVA would not act as the drain is not under their purview.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: This reflected an improvement in work processes and better understanding of the partners' area of responsibility.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: These improvements were made possible through the efforts of MSO and the partner agencies.

speaker: Mdm Speaker
text: We still do not know what happened to the python in the monsoon drain.
